tasks.commitBody:
Season management toolbar reduced to a single right-aligned cogwheel
that toggles the panel open and closed (aria-expanded); the panel's
internal close button is gone. The page-level '+ Sündmus' button is
removed — events are created from inside the panel — and its 'agenda'
origin path is deleted. '+ Hooaeg' keeps its existing gate. While a
bulk series or conversion run is unfinished the cogwheel renders
disabled, following the existing blocked-entry-point precedent, so the
panel stays open to show progress. With at most one toolbar button
visible at a time, the toolbar role and roving tabindex are dropped in
favour of normal tab order.

Closes #213

tasks.commitBody:
Series creation preview lists every generated occurrence as a native
toggle chip (YYYY-MM-DD) in a wrapping grid grouped by month; tapping a
chip skips that date (shown struck and muted, still visible) and
tapping again restores it. The count line updates live and the submit
button is disabled when every date is toggled off. The separate
skip-date input, Add button and removable chip list are removed along
with their four message keys. The submit, snapshot and per-collective
resume contracts are unchanged: the skip set still feeds recurrence
generation.

Supersedes #200's discoverability heading (already closed).

Closes #215

tasks.commitBody:
Seasons can be deleted from the season management panel. A two-step
confirmation quotes the live scope (series, events, repertoire items)
read from Entu, then deleteSeason cascades serially children-before-
parent: each series (with its occurrences), standalone events,
repertoire items, then the season itself, failing loudly with a
partial-progress error if a step is refused. A progress counter
'Kustutan X / Y…' renders under the series list during the cascade,
where Y is every entity the cascade will delete; series deletion now
shows the same counter via an optional progress callback on
deleteEventSeries (folds #216). After a successful delete the panel
closes and the manageable season is recomputed.

New keys season_delete_confirm_scope, season_manage_delete_progress,
season_delete_success in en/et/lv/uk.

Closes #217
Closes #216
